steps.heading: The two-pane reader
steps.text: Every paper (and slide deck) opens here: a toolbox on the left, the source document itself on the right. This is also where a citation preview links back to when you click through.

steps.heading: Navigate, Jump, Sources, Cited, Meta
steps.text: Navigate searches this document's own text and browses its table of contents. Jump goes straight to a page, a chunk, or an exact phrase. Sources and Cited are the S2 bibliography and citing-papers graphs. Meta is the bibliographic record — edit it here.

steps.heading: Search inside the document
steps.text: Semantic search finds passages by meaning, keyword by exact words; TOC browses the outline; Raw reads the ingested body verbatim when there's no PDF to fall back on. Click a result to jump the pane on the right to it.

steps.heading: The document itself
steps.text: The actual PDF, rendered in place — every jump from the sidebar scrolls it to the matching page or passage. A stub with no PDF on disk still gets Navigate and Jump over whatever chunks are ingested.
